The preferred path (execute P34.17's L2 republish of release

inside this ticket**:

- **Copy-batch sitting is the operator's act (D-P35.38a-1 OPEN).** Every

  source build; the fallback's injected page carries the ruling-named

- **The preferred build also ships other Round-11 web changes** → the

The fallback transform is committed engineering — the in-PR script

never a hand-edit (contract § "The fallback transform").
